result:
Both commits are local only, as instructed (no push).

- **`891ba43`** — added `POST /api/notes/subject/:id/generate` (generates every module lacking fresh notes via `generateModuleNotes`, then assembles; gated by the existing `notes_view` rate limit), wired the reading page's "Generate notes" button to it via new `generate()`/`isGenerating` on `useSubjectNotes`, and added the `vercel.json` timeout entry. `891ba43` — **`4aca02b`** fills in the SHA/notes in FIX_LEDGER.md and appends the PROGRESS.md entry.
- Verified against a real zero-notes subject on the live dev server: happy path (5/5 modules generated, cache hit on immediate re-GET) plus unhappy paths — concurrent double-generate (both 200, no race), nonexistent subject (404 not 500), and a real browser interrupted-flow click-through (navigated away mid-generation, came back, notes rendered correctly — the two console errors during the away-navigation were the browser reporting its own aborted fetch, not a server fault, confirmed against the dev server log). Test subject's `study_notes` rows were restored to 0 after both harnesses. `tsc`/lint/build all clean, no new lint findings.
- No migration needed. CP-11 was not actually HALT-gated per FIX_SPEC.md (only CP-01 is), so no approval pause was required.
